compute_bleu_score: compute the BLEU score of a candidate sentence against a list of reference sentences
normalize_and_tokenize_text: normalize and tokenize text using NIST-style preprocessing for machine translation evaluation
count_ngrams_in_words: count n-grams of a given order in a list of words and return their frequencies
cook_reference_sentences: preprocess a list of reference sentences into a form usable for BLEU scoring
cook_test_sentence: preprocess a candidate test sentence against cooked references to prepare for BLEU scoring
